verdict.rationale: Pandoc's site lists each format with a direction marker: ← for input-only (CSV, TSV, Excel), → for output-only (ICML, PDF via named engines) and ↔ for both ways (ipynb). The CLI also prints the supported sets via --list-input-formats and --list-output-formats, which together let a user check whether a pair works before trying it. Pair-level fidelity is not documented, though, and user reports of lossy conversions (Org-mode links, complex documents) suggest a supported pair may still convert poorly. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that any input converts to any output, and per-pair fidelity or limitation notes.
